MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable 2TB drive feels like a useful next step after my memory cards and card reader because I could use it to back up photos and files.",
    "The HD Fire TV Stick would add streaming to my existing 720p TV, giving equipment I already own a useful new function."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The 16TB drive and 24-port switch offer far more capacity or connections than I currently need; interest in storage and accessories does not mean I need large-scale equipment.",
    "The audio cables have no identified connection to make in my setup, even though I have bought other practical cables.",
    "My photography accessories do not imply a need for a monitoring camera, and owning a tablet does not give me a reason to add a smart display or voice assistant.",
    "The 4K streaming stick's extra resolution does not benefit my listed 720p TV, so the HD option fits my intended use better."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in additional electronic devices, although my choices usually serve specific equipment needs.",
    "My memory-card purchases seem to have been stretched into interest in storage of any size, and my Fire tablet purchase into interest in more Alexa devices."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Compatibility matters: my cases, mounts, chargers and lens cap serve particular devices or connections, so another accessory needs a similarly clear purpose.",
    "My memory cards and card reader suggest a practical photo-and-file workflow, which makes portable backup storage more relevant than unrelated smart-home devices.",
    "The capabilities of equipment I already own matter, including my TV's 720p resolution and the functions my tablet already provides."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in useful equipment upgrades, but often missed the specific compatibility, scale and purpose behind my purchases."
}
